question: The Shumang Leela festival is associated with which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Shumang Leela** is a popular** theatre festival **in the **state of Manipur**, showcasing **traditional plays and performances.**
 
• The festival is a celebration of the **state's rich cultural heritage **and is** held annually** in various parts of Manipur.
 
• It is often referred to as the** "theatre of the masses"** as it is **accessible and enjoyed **by people from all walks of life.
 
• The festival has been recognized by the **Government of India **as an important event in the country's **cultural calendar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1,** Jharkhand, is** not associated** with the Shumang Leela festival.

 
 
• Jharkhand has its own unique cultural traditions and festivals.
 
 
 
• **Option 2, **Bihar, is also **not associated** with the Shumang Leela festival.
 
 
• Bihar has several popular festivals such as **Chhath Puja,** but Shumang Leela is not one of them.
 
 
 
• **Option 4,** Assam, is also** not associated** with the Shumang Leela festival.
 
 
• Assam has its own unique cultural traditions and festivals such as **Bihu**, but Shumang Leela is not one of them.
